$comment: The scenario definition. One file, read by the Python harness and by the Node adapters, so no runtime can quietly measure something else. Override at the command line with --jobs / --concurrency / --payload-bytes.
$jobs: 500 rather than a round 10000: the published run crosses a ~36 ms network to Redis, and the slowest entrant drains ~1.3 jobs/s over it. 500 keeps a full run inside half an hour while still putting the 5th-worst sample at p99.
